department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: January 15, 2027 is the Fall 2027 financial consideration deadline; later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until April 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Civil and Environmental Engineering Spring 2027 October 15, 2026 Fall 2027 Financial Consideration Deadline January 15, 2027

app_fee.value: The Swanson School of Engineering sets its own application fee, which is not published on the pages checked; the Dietrich School $75 does not apply.

fee_waiver.value: The Swanson School approves application fee waivers case by case on qualifications and financial need, through its own request form.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waiver requests are approved on a case-by-case basis as determined by qualifications and financial need.

gre_general.quote: GRE scores: Applicants should consider the GRE an optional submission.

toefl_min.value: Swanson School minimum is 4.5 overall on the new TOEFL scale (81 on the old scale), with ESL courses recommended below 5.0.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL - After Jan 21, 2026 4.5 total score under 5.0

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum 6.5 overall, with ESL courses recommended below 7.5.

english_waiver.value: Swanson waives the test only for a degree from an institution in an English-speaking country; India is not named and the Dietrich School country list does not apply, so confirm with the school.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants must submit scores from an English language proficiency exam unless they have earned a degree from an institution in an English-speaking country.

funding.value: Swanson offers a limited number of highly competitive teaching and research assistantships, primarily at the PhD level; admission does not include funding automatically.
funding.quote: The Swanson School of Engineering offers a limited number of highly competitive teaching and research assistantships, primarily at the PhD level.

also.quote: Admission to a graduate program does not automatically include funding.

entry_route.value: A degree in engineering or a hard science is required, with an undergraduate QPA of 3.30/4 for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Degree in engineering or in hard sciences (such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, computer science) or background equivalent to an undergraduate engineering degree

also.quote: An Undergraduate QPA equivalent to 3.00 for M.S., 3.30 for Ph.D., based on A = 4.00 is required.
